Điều khoản sử dụng và Quy tắc cộng đồng: Terms of use and Community Guidelines
Kinnect do Mr Ánh vận hành. Liên hệ hỗ t: Kinnect is operated by Mr Ánh. Support, privacy and child safety contact: anhvn53@wru.vn. This policy applies to the Kinnect Android app and website; updated October 29, 2026.
Kinnect lưu tên đăng nhập, tên hiển thị,: Kinnect stores usernames, display names, password hashes and login sessions; email if linked or used for social login; profiles and voluntarily shared details such as age, city, gender, orientation, interests, height/weight; photos, videos, posts, comments, messages, follows/friendships, reports and consent choices. Do not provide sensitive information you do not wish to share.
Dữ liệu dùng để vận hành tài khoản, hiển: Data is used to operate accounts, display profiles according to privacy choices, connect members, provide messaging/calls, prevent abuse and review reports. Camera and microphone are used only when you choose a relevant feature and grant permission. The system file picker grants access only to selected files. Approximate location is obtained only when you enable Nearby; turn it off and delete it in Settings.
Máy chủ và dịch vụ mạng/hosting, gồm Clo: Server and network/hosting services, including Cloudflare, process data to deliver and operate the service. Profile images, posts and public photo/video content may be sent to Cloudflare Workers AI or NVIDIA to assist moderation. The support AI assistant is enabled only after your explicit consent; when enabled, your message and up to 6 related support-chat messages are sent to those providers. Turn off AI and continue contacting the administrator at any time. Do not send passwords, one-time codes, payment details or sensitive data to AI. Google/Facebook process login when you choose them. Providers are used only for service delivery and applicable legal requirements.
Các thành viên chỉ thấy hồ sơ/nội dung t: Members see profiles/content according to visibility choices and access checks enforced by the server. Data is transmitted over HTTPS; passwords are hashed. Messages are not end-to-end encrypted: the server operator can access stored data for operations, requests and moderation. Do not describe this as end-to-end security.
Thông tin tài khoản, nội dung và lựa chọ: Account information, content and choices are retained while the account exists, or until you delete content using supported features. Location is stored until disabled/deleted or the account is deleted; stale location is not used for Nearby visibility. Expired recovery codes are immediately invalid and cleaned during hourly maintenance. Password recovery requests are kept for up to 90 days; request earlier deletion through private contact. Confirming account deletion in the app or website removes related data from the active database and revokes every session when the request succeeds. Groups with other members transfer to another owner; your group content is deleted. Operational backups, if any, are isolated, not used to serve accounts, and must be deleted within 30 days; deleted accounts must not be restored. Data retained for legal obligations or safety is limited to the necessary scope, purpose and duration, with notice where legally allowed.
Bạn có thể sửa/ẩn thông tin, tắt vị trí,: Edit/hide information, disable location, change message permissions, block/report and request account deletion. In the app: Settings & privacy → Delete account and data. Outside the app: https://app.kinnect.io.vn/delete-account. No installation is needed. If you cannot log in or want access/correction/deletion of specific data, contact anhvn53@wru.vn privately; ownership is verified before processing. Do not send passwords, one-time codes or sensitive data through public GitHub pages.
Kinnect chỉ dành cho người đủ 18 tuổi, k: Kinnect is for adults aged 18 and over and does not serve minors. Do not misrepresent your age. When an underage account or child abuse risk becomes known, access is restricted and safety procedures apply. Age confirmation is self-declared and must not be advertised as identity verification. Significant data changes will be announced and consent requested again when needed. No advertising SDK or sale of personal data for advertising is currently integrated.
Bạn phải đủ 18 tuổi và đồng ý các quy tắ: You must be at least 18 and accept these rules before creating or sharing content on Kinnect. Do not impersonate, misstate your age or use another person's account. You may leave the service and delete your account.
Tôn trọng danh tính, giới, xu hướng tính: Respect identity, gender, sexual orientation and privacy. Discrimination, threats, stalking, harassment, contact after being blocked, fraud and sharing others' private information are prohibited. Being LGBT or having a particular appearance is not itself a reason to report a violation.
Không đăng hoặc truyền nội dung bất hợp: Do not post or transmit illegal content, pornography, explicit sexual acts, sexually gratifying content, sexual services or compensated relationships; severe violence, incitement to hatred, fraud or copyright infringement. Do not use photos, videos or music without usage rights.
Cấm CSAE/CSAM, dụ dỗ trẻ em, tống tiền t: CSAE/CSAM, grooming, sextortion, trafficking and all sexual exploitation or endangerment of children are prohibited, including AI-generated images. Do not save, reupload or distribute suspected content as evidence. Public standards: https://kinnect.io.vn/child-safety.

Nghiêm cấm xâm hại và bóc lột tình dục t: Child sexual abuse and exploitation (CSAE), child sexual abuse material (CSAM), grooming, sextortion, child trafficking, and sexual exploitation or endangerment of children are strictly prohibited, including simulated or AI-generated content. Minors may not use the service.
Báo cáo ngay trong ứng dụng qua nút Báo: Report in the app using Report on content/profiles or Help and support. We report to competent authorities as required by applicable law; prohibited material is not shared through GitHub or public channels.

Khi cửa hàng Google Play được mở bán, Go: When Google Play checkout is available, Google processes payments and card details; Kinnect does not receive card numbers or security codes. Kinnect sends a hashed account identifier and purchase token to Google for verification, and stores product IDs, status, verification time and encrypted purchase tokens to restore access and handle canceled/refunded purchases. Access belongs to the purchasing Kinnect account and cannot move to another account. Deleting the account removes purchase data stored by Kinnect and access; it does not automatically refund purchases or delete Google history. Request refunds through Google Play. If re-verification is unavailable, paid access may be suspended after up to 24 hours; free features remain available.
